title: Decommission v0 rollout router, remove legacy flag compatibility shim, and consolidate config versions
creator: Diego Morales
description: Background: Over several product iterations we accumulated multiple versioned rollout routers (v0/v1) and a compatibility shim that maps deprecated feature flags into current flag schemas for older clients. These shims and v0 routing paths increase code complexity, cause intermittent config mismatches during rollouts, and complicate kernel selection logic in the serving runtime. This ticket removes the v0 rollout router and the legacy flag-compat shim, migrates remaining v0 configs to the canonical v1 schema, and collapses versioned config handling into a single normalized format. The goal is to reduce cognitive overhead, remove runtime branching, and eliminate a known source of regressions in canary rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: All v0 rollout router routes removed from routing service; no incoming traffic is routed via v0 after deploy
Legacy flag compatibility shim code removed and deleted from repo; no runtime references to legacy flag mappings
All persisted configs in S3/ConfigDB previously marked v0 are migrated to v1 schema with validated transformations
CI builds and canary tests exercise the consolidated config code-paths and pass without false positives
Runtime metrics for routing errors, config parse failures, and rollout mismatches show no regression versus baseline after rollout
Comprehensive migration playbook committed to docs with verification steps and rollback instructions
plan: Inventory: run scan job to enumerate all v0 config objects, flags, and service references (scripts in infra/tools)
Transform: implement idempotent v0->v1 migrator library with unit tests and sample mappings
Code: remove v0 router code-path behind feature gate; implement consolidation of versioned parsing into single parser
Migration: batch-migrate config objects with staged pipeline (dry-run -> preview -> apply) and record hashes pre/post
Deploy: roll out to staging, run end-to-end rollout tests, then progressive canary to prod with metric guards
Cleanup: once metrics stable, remove feature gates and delete legacy code + deprecated API endpoints
Docs + SDK: update SDKs and API docs to reflect removed endpoints and new config schema
risks: Edge clients still relying on v0 semantics could fail if migration misses a mapping
Large batch migration could spike config service load — needs throttling
Rollout timing overlap with other infra changes could create transient mismatches
Undiscovered references to the shim in third-party integrations (internal partner services)
monitoring: Create temporary dashboards: routing_error_rate, config_migration_failure_count, rollout_mismatch_rate
Add alerts: >0.5% increase in routing_error_rate sustained for 5m -> page oncall
Add migration audit log stream to datadog index and retention for 30d
Track canary latency and error percentiles for models routed by consolidated code-path
rollback_plan: If migration errors exceed thresholds, pause pipeline and revert to pre-migration snapshots stored in S3
Re-enable feature gate that routes select traffic back to v0 (kept for emergency only) and attach a traffic limiter
Notify downstream teams via #infra-rollouts Slack and run manual reconciliation for affected configs
